result.summary: The page looks generally well-designed and consistent. A few minor visual issues were found: a truncated restaurant name in the horizontal carousel and a partially cut-off card at the bottom edge, which are typical of scrollable layouts but could be improved.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is truncated without an obvious way to see the full name on the card itself.
issues.suggestion: Allow the name to wrap to two lines, or use an ellipsis with a tooltip/long-press to reveal the full name; also consider indicating the carousel is scrollable (e.g., partially visible card is good, but ensure the full name is accessible).

issues.description: The bottom 'Popular right now' card (the −20% pizza card) is cut off mid-image at the screen edge, which can look broken at first glance if there is no visible scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle scroll hint (e.g., partial next card, fade edge, or page dots) so users understand the list continues below.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' card lacks a visible delivery-fee/discount badge like its neighbors (Green Bowl Poké and the ramen card show €0 delivery badges), making the card row visually inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Either add a badge (e.g., delivery time or fee) to all cards or standardize badge placement across carousel cards.
